name: Autocomplete Extras
description: Enhances Drupal's autocomplete widget with per-instance settings for minimum input length and maximum number of results.
project_description: Autocomplete Extras adds per-instance configuration to Drupal's core autocomplete widgets. On an entity-reference autocomplete or link-field widget it exposes two extra widget settings: the minimum number of characters a user must type before autocomplete fires, and the maximum number of suggestions returned. The same two controls can be applied site-wide to the Menu Link Content form's link field via an admin settings page. It ships no new autocomplete endpoint, no field type, no permissions and no plugins - it only alters existing core widgets and forms, reusing core's own autocomplete route, selection handlers and access checks.
